This page registers two WebMCP tools for manual verification of Browzy's webmcp_list_tools / webmcp_call_tool operations. It has no purpose beyond that.

  • echo_fixture_tool — returns a recognizable, deterministic value built from its input.
  • counter_fixture_tool — increments and returns an in-page counter, so repeated calls are visibly distinguishable.
